/**
 * ASCII-only lower casing, for values that are not proven ASCII.
 */
export function asciiLowerAll(value: string): string {
	let points: number[] = [];
	for (const point of Array.from(value, (scalar) => scalar.codePointAt(0)!)) {
		if (((point >= 65) && (point <= 90))) {
			points.push((point + 32));
		} else {
			points.push(point);
		}
	}
	return points.map((point) => String.fromCodePoint(point)).join("");
}
